title.vi: Phân cụm: K-Means và hơn nữa

files.name: main.py
files.code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score

X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=300, centers=3, cluster_std=0.6, random_state=42)

km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(X)
print(sorted(np.bincount(km.labels_).tolist()))     # kích thước mỗi cụm
print("inertia:", round(km.inertia_, 1))
print("silhouette:", round(silhouette_score(X, km.labels_), 3))

for k in range(2, 7):                                # chọn k tốt nhất
    labels = KMeans(k, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit_predict(X)
    print(k, round(silhouette_score(X, labels), 3))

prompt.en: Run KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10, random_state=0) on the blobs data. Assign labels = km.labels_ and print the cluster sizes sorted ascending (sorted(np.bincount(labels).tolist())).

solution.code:
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score

X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=300, centers=3, cluster_std=0.6, random_state=42)
scores = {}
for k in range(2, 7):
    labels = KMeans(k, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit_predict(X)
    scores[k] = silhouette_score(X, labels)
best_k = max(scores, key=scores.get)
print(best_k)
